title: Bitcoin AI Call — 2026-11-11: SELL at 84% Confidence

intro: On November 11, 2026 the QuantAura four-model ensemble published a SELL call on Bitcoin at 84.5 percent confidence.
Bitcoin was trading at $73,421 when the call was made.
days: Twenty-four hours later the price had moved +0.62 percent, so the call was graded incorrect.
A SELL call needs price to move more than 1 percent in its direction within 24 hours to be graded correct.
trend: Going into the day, the public record stood at 35 hits and 58 misses over 93 graded calls, an accuracy of 37.6 percent.
